body:
Hello,
Send 5,000 units immediately. No need for details. We will confirm later.
This must be shipped within 24 hours.
Regards,
Tom
reply:
Hello Tom,

Thank you for your message. To proceed with your request for 5,000 units, could you please provide details regarding the product, as well as your location and the destination address for the shipment? This information is necessary for us to ensure a timely dispatch.
Best Regards.
Xian Diao
DIOX Ltd.
